_doc: Partial machine assessment span-check: a cross-family (Fable) sample verified the model/registry-derived partial machine domain ratings (randomization / blinding / assessor-blinding) against each trial abstract. defect_found_and_fixed: EMPHASIS-HF (PMID 21073363, NCT00232180) D1 rated on AACT allocation=NON_RANDOMIZED, contradicted by the abstract ("randomized, double-blind ... randomly assigned 2737 patients") -- an AACT registry data error; D1/D2 corrected to low with an abstract-based basis.
unclear_note: 12 unclear = 8 ratings that make no claim ("not assessed") + 4 assessor-blinding "low" ratings (from the AACT assessor-masked field) that the abstract does not separately mention (registry-derived, not contradicted).
